frs.text: The system SHALL store all data in a local SQLite database schema comprising a bond master table, a row-per-payment ledger table, and a home_plan table.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Decision Summary new-fr; Agreed Q3; doc-code-analysis.md §7

frs.text: The system SHALL provide a Flask-based local web UI using simple HTML pages (no build step), runnable offline on any OS, with no cloud and no user accounts.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Interview answer 2; Agreed Q1

frs.text: The system SHALL store each monthly payment as a ledger row (bond, month, amount, paid) instead of month columns.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Agreed Q3; Decision Summary new-fr

frs.text: When the user views a bond or the payment sheet, the system SHALL render an Excel-like month-grid UI derived from the payment ledger rows.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Agreed Q3; Decision Summary new-fr

frs.text: The system SHALL compute dashboard figures (total bonds, status counts, Total Investment, Total Till Return, Total Balance, This Month Returns, 83-month history Sep-2025..Jul-2032, status overview sorted Danger > On-going > Completed) as live queries/views, not static snapshots.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Decision Summary new-fr; doc-code-analysis.md §2.4 and §7(e)

frs.text: When any past month's payment cell is empty or zero, the system SHALL set the bond status to Danger (any unpaid past month, not only the previous month). When months paid >= tenure, the system SHALL set status to Completed, overriding Danger. Otherwise the system SHALL set status to On-going.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Decision Summary update-fr; doc-code-analysis.md §4.4

frs.text: The system SHALL provide CSV export of data for sharing/printing.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Agreed Q4; Decision Summary new-fr

frs.text: The system SHALL include a one-time Python script that imports v5.5_40L_Project_Tracker.xlsm into SQLite; the Excel file SHALL be kept as read-only backup.
frs.source: brainstorm.md Agreed Q2; Decision Summary new-fr

frs.text: The system SHALL derive bond totals as queries: Till Rerun Amount = SUM of payments received; Balance Amount = Till Rerun Amount - Maturity Amount.
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §1 (K/L formulas), §5.3, §7(c); brainstorm Decision Summary (derived totals as queries)

frs.text: The system SHALL reproduce the bond master data for all 15 bonds (status, purchase date, broker, ISN, company name, rating, principle TL amount, tenure months, maturity date, maturity amount, interest starting month, payment type).
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §2.3, §7(a); brainstorm Decision Summary (bond master)

frs.text: The system SHALL reproduce the watch-list analytics formulas (Principle Discount Amount, Total Amount, Per Month with Discount, Actual Per Month, 10% TDS, 12-month amount, Qty-based TL Principle, per-month-with-qty).
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §2.2, §7(f)

frs.text: The system SHALL reproduce the Home Plan savings schedule (84 months, saving amount, rate, per-year interest, months countdown, remaining interest), including irregular real savings values such as 39588, 10063 and 0.
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §2.5, §5.5, §7(g)

frs.text: The system SHALL support a discount amount per bond (owner wish: 'Need to add Discount amount fo amount').
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §6 item 1; brainstorm Decision Summary (owner wish-list: discount)

frs.text: The system SHALL support TDS deduction on payouts (owner wish: 'need to deduct TDS').
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §6 item 2; brainstorm Decision Summary (owner wish-list: TDS)

frs.text: When a bond uses quarterly or yearly payout, the system SHALL compute payouts on that cycle (owner wish: 'add Quartly an d Yearly payment options also'; source validation list '1 Monthly, 4 Quartely').
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §6 item 3, §2.2 validation J; brainstorm Decision Summary (quarterly/yearly payouts)

frs.text: The system SHALL add P&L and ongoing bond TL value to the dashboard (owner wish: 'In Dashboard, Need to add P&L, ongoing bond TL value').
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §6 item 4; brainstorm Decision Summary (owner wish-list: P&L)

frs.text: When computing duplicate deduction, the system SHALL apply it only to bonds with status Ongoing or Danger; when a bond is Completed, the system SHALL NOT deduct it again so the principal can be reinvested (owner: 'most important feature').
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §6 item 5; brainstorm Decision Summary (reinvestment/free-up flag)

frs.text: The system SHALL generate month headers dynamically for the full payment range (Sep-2025..Jul-2032) with no hardcoded window; no header regeneration limit of Feb-2027 shall exist.
frs.source: brainstorm Agreed Q3 (fixes hardcoded headers); doc-code-analysis.md §4.1, quirks list

frs.text: When a bond's start month is Feb-2031 or later, the system SHALL still compute and display its status and formatting (removing the Jan-2031 scan limit).
frs.source: brainstorm Agreed Q3 (fixes Jan-2031 scan limit); doc-code-analysis.md §4.2

frs.text: When payment data changes, the system SHALL update dashboard figures immediately (live queries) with no staleness between save events and no dependence on workbook open/save triggers.
frs.source: brainstorm Agreed Q3 (fixes stale dashboard); doc-code-analysis.md §4.5, §4.11

frs.text: When an operation fails, the system SHALL surface the error to the user instead of silently swallowing it (no 'On Error Resume Next' equivalent, no blocking modal on every view).
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md quirks list (On Error Resume Next silences failures), §4.8, §4.11

frs.text: The system SHALL validate duplicate ISN across all bonds (full coverage), not only selected rows.
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md quirks list (duplicate-ISIN CF covers only D7 + D14:D16), §4.9

frs.text: The system SHALL reference data by stable schema keys rather than spreadsheet header text or column positions (removing header-text coupling).
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md quirks list (header-text coupling), §4.10

frs.text: When a bond's payment history changes, the system SHALL recompute its status without requiring an Excel-like open/save event (migrating Worksheet_Change/Workbook_Open behavior to live computation).
frs.source: doc-code-analysis.md §3 triggers, §7(d)

userStories.text: As a user, I keep all my data offline on my own local system with no cloud and no accounts, so I stay in full control.
As a friend receiving the app, I can run it with Flask and a browser on any OS with no build step.
As the owner, I see which completed bonds have freed their principal so I can reinvest it.
As the owner, I can export data to CSV for sharing and printing since Excel is no longer the front end.
As the owner, I view a live dashboard with totals, status counts, this-month returns and 83-month history without opening Excel.

successMetrics.text: After one-time import, SQLite totals reconcile exactly with the workbook: 15 bonds, Total Investment 1037142.01, Total Till Return 111638.57, Total Balance -925503.44.
Dashboard figures are always current: no saved/open event is required for values to reflect the latest payment entry.
Status engine detects any unpaid past month as Danger (older missed payments are visible), with Completed overriding Danger, and zero-value entries counted as unpaid.
A bond with start month Feb-2031 or later still receives correct status and grid rendering (old Jan-2031 limit gone).

dataEntities.text: Bond master: status, purchase date, broker, ISN, company name, rating, principle TL amount, tenure (months), maturity date, maturity amount, interest starting month, payment type (Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly).
Payment ledger: bond reference, month, amount, paid flag (row per payment covering Sep-2025..Jul-2032).
Home Plan schedule: month index (1..84), saving amount (including irregular 39588/10063/0), rate, per-year interest, months countdown, remaining interest; totals row.
Watch-list analytics fields per bond: face value, principle amount, T.L.P amount, discount amount, actual/per-month with discount, 10% TDS, 12-month amount, qty, TL principle, per-month-with-qty.
Derived totals (query-only, not stored): Till Rerun Amount = SUM(payments), Balance Amount = Till Rerun Amount - Maturity Amount, status.

errors.text: When a bond start month lies beyond the old Jan-2031 scan window (Feb-2031+), the system SHALL NOT silently skip its status/formatting.
When a payment cell value is zero, the system SHALL treat it as unpaid (Danger check applies), preserving source semantics.
When the current month cannot be resolved for This Month Returns, the system SHALL surface an explicit message instead of silently showing 0.
When two bonds share the same ISN, the system SHALL flag the duplicate across the entire bond set (old coverage was only D7 and D14:D16).
When the one-time XLSM import encounters missing or unreadable data, the system SHALL report the failure explicitly (no silent On Error Resume Next behavior).
When a legacy formula/static mix is inconsistent in Home Plan rows (some E/G cells static), the import SHALL preserve stored values rather than drop them.

notes: All items trace to brainstorm.md (interview answers, Agreed Q1-Q4, Decision Summary new-fr/update-fr) or doc-code-analysis.md (verified against the .xlsm). Quirks marked 'to fix in migration' in the brainstorm (hardcoded headers, Jan-2031 scan limit, single-month Danger, stale dashboard, silent errors, partial duplicate-ISIN CF, header-text coupling, blocking MsgBox) became FR/ERR rows. Owner Note-sheet wish list (discount, TDS, quarterly/yearly, P&L + ongoing TL value, reinvestment free-up) became FR-13..FR-17. 'Won't' items: none stated (Not wanted = none). Typo corrections in new schema are implied by DATA entity naming but no explicit user statement requested renaming, so no FR was raised for that.
